headline: Tightening Management of Money-Laundering Risks in Crypto-Asset Transactions
summary: Vietnam's National Assembly passed amendments to the State Bank law, the Anti-Money Laundering law and the Credit Institutions law on 24 August. The changes tighten money-laundering risk management in crypto-asset transactions.
why: Crypto-asset firms and banks operating in Vietnam must comply with anti-money-laundering rules, which affect how digital asset transactions are monitored and licensed.
